sentence: This project holds a workshop to examine how quantum computing and quantum sensing could help with problems in Earth system science.
This project studies how astrocytes respond to mechanical forces, using live cells grown in brain-like environments.
This project studies how managing information affects the security of power grids and other systems facing an adversary.
This project builds a research network at a university, with upgraded fiber, switching and routing for large data transfers.
This project builds a compact sensor that tracks small electrical changes in cells as they swallow and clear targets.
This project teaches cybersecurity across hardware, systems, software and web, including artificial intelligence and cryptography ideas.
This project develops models and methods that help power grid operators manage energy storage and renewable energy more efficiently.
This project explores open-source, cyber-secure chip design and builds semiconductor curricula from it.
This project studies what makes the features that neural networks learn from data good, and how the networks store those features.
This project develops ways to capture and recycle nitrogen from waste and to produce nitrogen-based fertilizers.
This project develops ways for robotic ships, underwater vehicles and aerial drones to navigate safely and work together to monitor coastal waters.
This project tests a tethered drone platform that combines several sensors to watch large sites where objects block the view.
This project studies how injuries happen and how to prevent and treat them, using imaging and mechanics.
This project supports a meeting where scientists who study vision share work on perception, recognition and neuroimaging.
This project tests two explanations of how people disengage attention from visual distractions, using behavioral and neural measures.
This project builds AI-driven learning environments that create interactive stories and studies how learners solve problems together.
This project studies the diversity, evolution and ecology of free-living marine nematodes and the genome features that help them adapt to environmental stress.
This project studies how budding yeast controls its cell size, using super-resolution imaging and a mathematical model.
This project acquires an instrument for mass spectrometry to study proteins, peptides and small compounds such as metabolites.
